API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIBandwidth Control & ClassesBandwidth Control Rule Resource Update Rule
Bandwidth Control Rule Resource Update Rule
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/bandwidthControlRules/:ruleId

Updates the Bandwidth Control policy rule based on the specified ID

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
ruleId
int32
REQUIRED

Bandwidth Control rule ID

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
id
int32

System-generated identifier for bandwidth control rule

name
string
REQUIRED

Rule name

order
int32

Rule order. Policy rules are evaluated in ascending numerical order (Rule 1 before Rule 2, and so on), and the Rule Order reflects this rule’s place in the order. You can change the value, but if you've enabled the Admin Rank, your assigned admin rank determines the Rule Order values you can select.

state
string

Indicates whether the rule is enabled or disabled. An enabled rule is actively enforced. A disabled rule is not actively enforced but does not lose its place in the rule order. The service skips it and moves to the next rule.

Possible values: [DISABLED, ENABLED]

locations
object[]
timeWindows
object[]
description
string

Additional information about the rule

protocols
string[]

Possible values: [ANY_RULE, DOHTTPS_RULE, TUNNELSSL_RULE, HTTP_PROXY, FOHTTP_RULE, FTP_RULE, HTTPS_RULE, HTTP_RULE, SSL_RULE, TUNNEL_RULE]

locationGroups
object[]
maxBandwidth
int32

The maximum percentage of a location’s bandwidth to be guaranteed for each selected bandwidth class. This percentage includes bandwidth for uploads and downloads.

minBandwidth
int32

The minimum percentage of a location’s bandwidth you want to be guaranteed for each selected bandwidth class. This percentage includes bandwidth for uploads and downloads.

bandwidthClasses
object[]
rank
int32

Admin rank of the Bandwidth Control policy rule

lastModifiedTime
int32

Timestamp of when the rule was last modified. This field is not applicable to the Lite API.

lastModifiedBy
object
accessControl
string

Access privilege of this rule based on the admin's Role Based Authorization (RBA) state

Possible values: [NONE, READ_ONLY, READ_WRITE]

labels
object[]
devices
object[]
deviceGroups
object[]
deviceTrustLevels
string[]

List of device trust levels for which the rule must be applied. While the High Trust, Medium Trust, or Low Trust evaluation is applicable only to Zscaler Client Connector traffic, Unknown evaluation applies to all traffic. The trust levels are assigned to the devices based on your posture configurations in the Zscaler Client Connector Portal. If no value is set, this field is ignored during the policy evaluation.

Possible values: [ANY, UNKNOWN_DEVICETRUSTLEVEL, LOW_TRUST, MEDIUM_TRUST, HIGH_TRUST]

defaultRule
boolean

A Boolean value that indicates whether the rule is a default rule
